_doc: NTEE major groups a grantseeker can belong to. `topic` is websearch_to_tsquery text (OR between alternatives) used by /api/eval/facts to count a funder's grants on the topic. `missions` seed the synthetic nonprofit profiles. Y (mutual benefit) and Z (unknown) are left out: nobody searches for funders as those.

A.label: Arts, culture and humanities
A.topic: arts OR museum OR theater OR theatre OR music OR dance OR orchestra OR culture OR humanities
missions: community theater programs for youth and families
music lessons for children who cannot afford them
a local history museum and its education programs
